02 · SOMEHOW, I FOUND YOU

And then somehow…

Two people who weren't looking for love found each other anyway.

We met unexpectedly on an app. I wasn't looking for love, and you weren't either. I just messaged you… and you replied.

We started as strangers. Then friends. Then best friends. You became my suitor for a little while—even though you didn't want it. 😭 And somehow, after all of that, you became my boyfriend.

Sometimes I think about how one tiny decision—one message, one reply—can change the whole direction of a person's life.

I'm so thankful that it changed mine.

our story is my favorite coincidence.
03 · US

04 · A LETTER

To my Seony

My Seony,

Happy birthday, my love. 🤍

Sometimes I still think about how unexpected everything between us was. I wasn't looking for love, and you weren't looking for it either. We were just two people who happened to meet on an app.

And I'm still so thankful that I decided to message you—and even more thankful that you replied.

We started as strangers. Then we became friends, then best friends. You became my suitor for a short while, even though you didn't want to admit you wanted that role for very long. 😭 And somehow, after all of that, you became my boyfriend.

And now, when I think about my future, I don't just see you as my boyfriend.

I see you as the man I want to marry.

I know you're not perfect. I'm not perfect either. But I don't want a perfect person. I want you.

You're the first person who has made me feel loved in a way I've never experienced before. You have shown me a kind of love that makes me feel safe, appreciated, and cared for.

There are so many kilometers between the Philippines and Korea right now, and I hate that I can't be beside you to celebrate your birthday. I wish I could hug you, look at you, annoy you a little, and tell you in person how much you mean to me.

But until that day comes, I hope this little gift reminds you that there is someone on the other side of the world thinking about you and loving you.

Thank you for replying to that random message. Thank you for becoming my best friend. Thank you for choosing me. And thank you for letting me imagine a future with you.

Happy birthday, Seony.

I hope this new year of your life brings you happiness, good health, beautiful memories, and everything you've been wishing for.

And selfishly, I hope I get to be there for many of those memories.

One day, I don't want to celebrate your birthday through a screen. I want to be beside you.

Happy birthday to the man I love and the man I hope to call my husband someday.

I love you. 🤍

— your girl, from the Philippines to Korea

07 · UNTIL WE DON'T HAVE TO COUNT THE KILOMETERS

One day…

I don't want to send you birthday wishes through a screen.

I don't want kilometers between us.

I don't want to celebrate you from another country.

I want to wake up next to you.

I want to annoy you on your birthday.

I want to buy your cake.

I want to hug you.

I want to be there for all the ordinary birthdays after this one.

Until then, I'll keep loving you from here.
🇵🇭 ♡ 🇰🇷

Happy birthday, Seony.
My boyfriend, my best friend, and hopefully one day, my husband.

— your girl 🤍
